name: phasis/phasis
description: Pure PHP JavaScript engine. Lexes, parses, and executes ECMAScript without Node.js, FFI, or extensions.

suggest.ext-intl: Required for Intl.* APIs (Collator, NumberFormat, DateTimeFormat, etc.) and full Temporal calendar support. Without it, Intl constructors throw and non-ISO calendars fall back to limited semantics.
suggest.ext-openssl: Required for crypto.subtle AES-CBC / AES-CTR / AES-GCM encrypt/decrypt. crypto.subtle.digest, sign, and verify (HMAC) work without it via PHP's built-in hash() / hash_hmac().
